problem: Reuse admission currently proves that a customization has a review and evidence, but does not prove that the review escaped the local component and checked higher/lower reuse layers.

selected.reason: Preserves one governance authority and turns the existing review registry into a hierarchical search contract without adding runtime dependencies.

considered.candidate: Existing reuse-first checker and review registry
considered.note: Already fail-closes patches/plugins/adapters and already runs on private/neko-overlay-v1 plus agent/** pushes.

considered.candidate: Existing architecture freeze and plugin admission gates
considered.note: They constrain authority/capability ownership but do not prove search breadth.
No second CI workflow or service is required.
Repository-local static JSON validation does not justify another policy authority or service.
Not machine-enforceable and can be skipped by long-lived agent branches.

acceptance: Every strict review explicitly records every hierarchy layer as checked or not_applicable.
Checked layers carry evidence and an outcome.
thin_adapter requires L5 checked; self_implement requires L6 checked.
reuse_native requires L1 or L2 checked; reuse_external requires L3 or L4 checked.
Reviews dated before the enforcement cutoff remain historically intact rather than being falsely backfilled.
